title: Where the Hum Points
description: The hum the halls have been keeping to themselves turns
out to be directional, and it points down a passage the
crystal does not follow. The candle-end somebody left
at the junction burns steady, unbothered by echoes.
The black gate is next: obsidian, and a portal frame
that somebody built and somebody else unlit, and a
Six stations, the same six, gone quiet.
The halls keep your footsteps for a long time behind
you. It is the closest thing the descent has had to
